agreement.localScope: Five captured trees including selected working changes
agreement.thisStep: Design only; no assembly, transformation, scan, push, deployment or cutover
agreement.detailedBoundaries: Layout/pnpm agreed; extraction and generation details remain proposed and require review before integration.

pathMappings.rule: Resolve exactly five unique complete captures to their destination prefixes. Reject collisions, absolute paths, traversal or missing identities.

history.mergeTreatment: No source commits, parents, merges, tags, refs or Git metadata imported. Original histories remain in originals/private captures.
history.ordering: No replay. Materialize sources by ascending serviceId and paths in UTF-8 byte order; reject collisions; create exactly one baseline.

commit.message: Consolidate five captured Hey Hey source trees
commit.rule: Fixed synthetic metadata is for reproducibility, not a cutoff. Use Git plumbing with raw bytes/modes and explicit metadata, bypass host filters, autocrlf, hooks and signing.

history.provenance: Private evidence maps each serviceId, captured revision, captureId and contentDigest to the one baseline commit/tree and destination. No per-old-commit equivalents exist. Record path exclusions, moves and overlays privately.

baselineConstruction: Verify manifest/design bindings, five complete eligible captures, private receipt and every artifact/blob digest with the capture verifier. Never substitute mutable source checkouts.

Reconstruct captured revision; apply staged then unstaged binary-capable patches and selected untracked/ignored files. Captured direct entries/blobs govern final bytes, deletions, symlinks and modes, including working bytes hidden by filters/index flags. Verify each source content digest before mapping.

Collapse index/working distinction into the one baseline tree; preserve that distinction privately in captures. Apply explicit exclusions and quarantine, map through package boundaries, preserve all remaining bytes/modes.
Overlay only reviewed root tooling and inputs listed in rootOverlay, accounting separately for additions without changing captured facts.
Create parentless baseline with fixed metadata; retain private preservation comparisons and identity mapping. Verify original trees, refs and working changes are unchanged.

sourceExclusions.reason: Documented historical log/state dumps with token-shaped values; exclude exact paths without reading contents.

scopeExclusions: Graph and Embeddings stay separate; Agents, deployment config and Demos are not additional source trees.
Private snapshots, receipts, patches, raw provenance/comparisons, local absolute paths and source .git directories never enter candidate.
Unselected ignored/untracked material remains excluded by immutable capture decisions; assembly cannot broaden selection.

workflowQuarantine.rule: Preserve bytes/modes, record exact moves; activate nothing automatically. Replace publishing/version-push workflows deliberately during later reviewed integration.

generatedFiles.formerRecipe: Do not inherit API/UI Common generated-path filtering or Graph dependency filtering; Graph is outside candidate.
generatedFiles.laterRemovalGate: Separate reviewed integration delta must retain all spec/schema/fixture/builder/template/postprocessor inputs and pinned recipes, prove successful regeneration and pass affected checks before readiness.

rootOverlay.thisDesign: Include this file too; record its SHA-256 outside itself in the durable task outcome/private assembly evidence to avoid a self-hash cycle.
rootOverlay.rule: Use reviewed root bytes, not an unreviewed directory copy. Later assembler/verification tooling requires separately recorded hashes/deltas.

laterIntegration.commitPolicy: Separate reviewable commits after baseline, never folded silently into it.

laterIntegration.rule: Record exact content/path/mode deltas and governing digests. Review detailed proposed boundaries before implementation; no product behavior, publication or live deployment authority.

visibilityAndLicensing.observationScope: Current authorized working trees; recheck exact candidate. No licence metadata changed here.
visibilityAndLicensing.publicReadinessOwner: Later public-source readiness must reconcile OpenAPI ISC metadata/missing licence with AGPL decision, provide combined-root licensing and matching published package fields, and retain third-party notices. Local inclusion is not publication consent.
visibilityAndLicensing.publicationExclusions: Private capture artifacts/raw provenance remain private. Do not silently remove OpenAPI to bypass undecided consent; pause public push for explicit disposition.

invalidation: Any manifest, capture identity/content digest, receipt/artifact verification failure or missing source invalidates this binding; stop assembly.

Finish ongoing source work, recapture inputs and renew exact digest binding before expecting new changes in candidate. Never consume newer live bytes silently; immutable captures remain historical evidence.
Changes to boundary/generation designs, mappings, exclusions, root overlays or recipe require renewed review/binding. Never rewrite capture identities to match new files.
laterVerificationObligations: Implement/test assembly on small dirty-history fixtures; verify deterministic baseline identity and unchanged originals.
Verify each source bytes/deletions/modes/symlinks/working changes, accounting for exclusion/quarantine/overlay deltas.

Inspect exact candidate and all integration commits, resolve OpenAPI visibility/licensing, scan full candidate history for secrets before separate public-push approval.
reconciliation: Fresh baseline replaces former six-destination/pre-October replay assumptions for these five local inputs only. No cutoff or old commit replay; separate Graph/Embeddings work remains unchanged.
